verdict.rationale: Yapily documents its own enrichment capability: it categorises and analyses transaction data with merchant detection and spending insights (yapily-docs-3). That covers categories and, by implication, merchant identification. The evidence is a single summary line, with no detail on cleaned merchant names, logos, or how enriched fields appear on the transactions endpoint. missing for 10: merchant logos, explicit cleaned/normalised merchant-name fields, in-depth enrichment API docs or schema, independent or hands-on corroboration.
